S.FORM: alang Kukung ga niya mki sku Sincik Keng atu Gpho go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 25 buwan, 67 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 94% kyan ku 63 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 6% kyan ku 4 hi nya. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Kukung hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay 'zil na Kukung hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Kukung hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Kukung hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Kukung hya' ga Skaru. tay mkyahu' na Kukung hya' ga Ruba'. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ kukuŋ ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku [s|ɕ]in[ʦ|ʨ]ik keŋ atu ɣpħo ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan ** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku * ħi nja rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na kukuŋ ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔzil na kukuŋ ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na kukuŋ ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na kukuŋ ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na kukuŋ ħjaʔ ɣa [s|ɕ]karu taj mkjaħuʔ na kukuŋ ħjaʔ ɣa ruβaʔ reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
